title: P2 connection.register: response
description: The connection is written as pending (SEC-7). token_ref is generated by the core; the adapter stores the token under it. The connection becomes active only after the person confirms the connection_confirm card in their private chat.

id.description: Connection id with the prefix cn_.

token_ref.description: Reference in the deployment secret store: conn/<tenant>/<principal>/<id>.

audit_seq.description: Number of the operation's audit record in the tenant chain.
